sections.title: The people who’ll look after you.
sections.sub: A friendly, family-feel team, with positivity and patient care at its core.
Can’t see your question? Send us your details and our team will be in touch.
items: How much does a new patient check-up cost?
Your new patient check-up is £85, including X-rays. Any fees are discussed clearly in advance, with no hidden costs, so you know exactly what to expect before any treatment goes ahead.
What happens during a dental check-up?
A thorough examination of your teeth, gums and mouth. Your dentist looks for signs of tooth decay, gum disease, wear and other oral health concerns, with X-rays if needed.
I’m nervous about visiting the dentist. Can you help?
Yes. Many patients feel anxious about dental visits. Appointments are unhurried, everything is clearly explained, and you’re always in control. Just let the team know.
Can I book if I haven’t been to the dentist in years?
Yes. Whether it’s been six months or several years, you’ll be welcomed without judgement.
Will I need treatment straight away?
Not necessarily. Many issues can simply be monitored. If treatment is recommended, your dentist will explain why and help you plan next steps at a pace that suits you.
How often should I have a check-up?
Most patients benefit from a check-up every six months, but your dentist will advise based on your oral health, lifestyle and needs.
When are you open?
Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm. We’re closed at weekends.
Where are you, and can I park?
5 Station Road, Newport Pagnell, Milton Keynes MK16 0AG. There’s free on-site parking, with accessible spaces and a step-free entrance.
